name: Summon Angel
description: (Tag:holy)(Tag:summon)Temporarily summon a lower-ranking Angel or Holy Spirit from the Heavenly Realm, such as Light Fairies, Pixies, Unicorns, Principalities, 4 Winged Angels, etc., limited to Rare familiar power or less. Bound to your will, it needs your constant energy to stay and use magic; slain angels restore in the Heavenly Realm and can be resummoned, and more energy lets them exert more power. You can permanently bind one via a long prayer ceremony sacrificing appropriate valuables and energy.
